relTest.notes:
• Faster and smoother: albums, captions and the computer's photo list open faster on big projects; the camera does less work after each photo; full-screen photos load faster and use less memory.
• Computer page: photos come from the cache when you move between them, the project list no longer misses clicks, and the page opens right away without internet.
• New setting (Settings → Camera → Photo quality): High 95 by default (about 40% smaller files, looks the same) or Maximum 100.
• Shorter opening screen.
• The original photo gets its details once and is never rewritten afterwards.
